Build the future Plan to Run the Simulations of a Batch

Source: R/net.fn.scenarios_run.R
dot-batch_plan.Rd

Exported for the EpiModelHPC slurmworkflow step templates, which run the same code on a SLURM cluster; it is not meant to be called directly.

Usage

.batch_plan(control, strategy, n_cores)

Arguments

control

A control.net list. Its future.use.plan element is used as the plan when it holds one set with future::tweak().

strategy

A future backend function, e.g. future::multicore.

n_cores

The number of workers to use when control$future.use.plan holds no plan.

Value

A future plan: control$future.use.plan when it is a future::tweak() plan, else future::tweak(strategy, workers = n_cores).

Details

Only builds the plan: with(future::plan(<plan>), local = TRUE) must be called by the function running the simulations, as it resets the plan when its caller exits.

strategy is a function rather than a name, as future::tweak() looks a name up from the calling frame (this namespace, then the search path) before the future namespace.
